output.scope_note: The paper studies oxide-ion conducting Na0.5Bi0.465Sr0.02Eu0.005TiO3-δ ceramics and reports conductivity, but its own conductivity values appear only in figures; the one numeric conductivity in the text is a literature value quoted in the introduction.

records.evidence_quote: At 500 °C, the bulk conductivity (σb) of NB₀.₄₉T doped with 2 mol% Sr or 1 mol% Mg is approximately 5.0 × 10⁻³ S cm⁻¹, which is comparable to those of LSMG and GDC [9–11].
records.notes: Literature value quoted from refs [9-11], not measured in this paper. The paper's own Na0.5Bi0.465Sr0.02Eu0.005TiO3-δ conductivities (bulk, grain-boundary, total) appear only as Arrhenius plots in Figures 5-6 with no numbers in the text, so no record was made for them. Conclusions give activation energies of 0.68 eV (high pO2) and 0.88 eV (low pO2) for the own samples, but no conductivity value is attached to them.
